en.html:
A torrent of gravitational energy is released.
Its leading edge approaches.

Far weaker than the region around the vortex's centre.
Nevertheless, capture would severely restrict movement. The following waves could no longer be stopped. Imprisonment would be the likely result once more.

Such an outcome cannot be accepted.

Then withdraw?

No.

Withdrawal is unnecessary.

Against gravitational energy of this order, the castle walls will provide protection.

放たれる辰気の奔流。
　先端が目前に迫った。

　渦の中心付近に比べればずっと弱い。
　それでも捕まれば騎体運動を大きく阻害されるのは
避けられず、そうなれば続く流れを防ぐ事も叶わず、
再び虜囚に逆戻りするだろう。

　そんな始末は受け入れかねる。

　では逃げるか。

　否。

　逃げる必要はない。

　この程度の辰気なら、<ruby>城壁<rt>・・</rt></ruby>が防いでくれる。

Second and third waves of gravitational energy approach.
Still they do not reach me. The protective force remains.

The white moon's gravity repels the black vortex's pull and holds me in place.

This short time.
This very small opportunity to operate the armour.

All of it is to be spent on the single move that brings victory.

en.html:
Maximum output reached.
Search the lunar surface. Select a low hill and land.

The cut was certainly made.

The blade, swift as light, entered Starving Void—the formula of nothingness—cut it in two and brought its structure down.

The gravitational phenomenon should have dispersed.
Possibly along with the Silver Star itself.

It is difficult to suppose that the core alone escaped the blade.
At the least, considerable damage must have been sustained.

This will settle the contest.

Before a sword moving at light speed, anything must—

出力限界に到達。
　月面を<ruby>探査<rt>サーチ</rt></ruby>、小高い丘を選んで着陸する。

　確かに、斬った。
　
　飢餓虚空――虚無の術式に光迅の刃を入れ、両断し、
構成を崩壊へ導いた。

　辰気現象は霧散しただろう。
　あるいは、銀星号の騎体もろとも。

　中核のみが刃先から逃れたとは考えられない。
　少なくとも、相当の打撃は受けた筈だ。

　これで勝負は決する。

　光速の一剣の前には、何者も――

Not without damage, of course.
The Silver Star before me is beyond battered. On the verge of falling apart would be the correct description.

In this condition, how did it achieve movement of that order?
And—◆it is STILL maintaining the formula for Starving Void!!

Cannot understand.
What is this power?

I do not know.

—What is making this enemy fight to such an extent?!
